_what_this_is: A one-use chain that was built, launched, and refused at pod creation. The provider had usable secure L40S capacity at the moment of the $0 watch and none by the moment of the create call, which is the ordinary behaviour of `Low` stock on this account. No provider resource existed at any point.
launcher_message: ABORT: could not create a pod

cost._why_zero: no pod was ever created, so nothing billed

final_provider_state: nothing to tear down; no resource was created
_chain_disposition: The chain is CONSUMED even at $0 (P12.1): its authorization is one-use and must not be reused. A later attempt builds a fresh one under a new identity. The incrementing attempt number is not a scope expansion.
_closed_retrospectively: Written at C3 closeout. The acquisition loop was stopped after attempt66 reached a terminal scientific state, so these chains were left with directory scaffolding and no outcome record. Closing them is bookkeeping, not a new attempt.
